description:
WS6 of _project/planning/ci-failure-reduction-plan.md. Check-run sampling on 2026-07-23 shows WebKit (@smoke, non-blocking) failed on BOTH recent explorer-touching PRs (#1270, #1264, both 2026-07-22) while Firefox @smoke and Chromium full-suite passed both times - deterministic WebKit-specific breakage, not a flake. Note stabilize-webkit-browser-smoke-flake-under-parallel-workers is DONE, so this is likely a regression or a new breakage. Non-blocking-but-always-red is the worst state: it trains everyone to ignore red, and each failure uploads a ~160MB playwright-report artifact.

Timebox one diagnosis session. Then either (a) fix the root cause, or (b) move the WebKit job to nightly.yml with an auto-filed issue on failure and remove it from the PR lane until supported. Either way, trim failure-artifact size/retention (traces on first retry only, retention-days: 3). Also correct the PR-triage guidance that says 'Firefox/WebKit flake - ignore': Firefox is green; WebKit is known-broken and should reference this item. Related: graduate-browser-smoke-to-blocking-gates (graduation needs 10 consecutive greens - impossible until this lands).

anti_patterns.dont: Leave the job non-blocking-and-red as steady state
anti_patterns.instead: Fix it or move it out of the PR lane with an auto-filed tracking issue
anti_patterns.why: Expected-red normalizes ignoring CI and buries real failures

anti_patterns.dont: Mark the failing specs skip-on-webkit wholesale without diagnosis
anti_patterns.instead: Diagnose first; targeted skips only with linked issue and rationale
anti_patterns.why: Silently shrinks smoke coverage and fakes a graduation-ready green streak

preserves.behavior: Chromium full-suite blocking behavior is unaffected
If a src/ change turns out to be required for the fix, stop and re-scope this item first (scope deliberately excludes src/)
graduate-browser-smoke-to-blocking-gates remains the graduation path once green; its 10-consecutive-green criterion is unchanged

verifications.description: PR lane has zero expected-red checks: WebKit job either green on 3 consecutive explorer PRs or absent from PR-triggered workflow
verifications.expected: webkit job green in PR lane, or present only in nightly.yml

work_units.summary: Diagnose the deterministic WebKit @smoke failures on #1270/#1264 (compare against the stabilize-webkit... fix; identify regression point)
Fix root cause OR demote to nightly.yml with auto-filed issue on failure; remove from PR lane if demoted
Trim failure artifacts (trace-on-first-retry, retention-days 3) for all three browser jobs
Update triage guidance: Firefox is green; WebKit status tracked here (docs/operations)
